one_liner: SEO and SERP data analytics API providing comprehensive data solutions for SEO software development.
auth_notes: Uses HTTP Basic Authentication with API login and password passed in the headers.
gate_notes: Requires account registration and funded balance/paid plan to access the API endpoints.
verdict_reason: DataForSEO provides a robust REST API with clear documentation and standard Basic Authentication, making it ready for integration.

evidence.quote: Basic authentication is the only way to access DataForSEO API; credentials should always be passed in the header of the request.
DataForSEO API is using the REST technology for interchanging data between your application and our service.
